input.original_instruction: We start off facing some brown closet doors and you will see a bathtub. Walk between the bathtub and all of the wood furniture Taking a left walking toward the bed.Exiting out of the bedroom. Walking to the left of the bed and walking down a hallway, a very long hallway. Now we will go up a few stairs. At the top of these stairs, we will turn to the right. Going down a stair or two. You will see a piano directly in front of you. Walk to the left of the piano, passing a large fireplace. Walking out the glass doors with a pool directly in front of us. Now turn to the left. With the pool on the right and the home to your left, walk to the end, mostly to the end of this brick patio. You will stop when you are at the edge of the pool. There will be a potted plant on your left hand side.
